"3D Creator is a real-time 3D scanning system based on a single camera. It consists mainly of three mathematical parts:
1) Positioning in 3D space using only camera
2) Point cloud calculation based on two pictures
3) A 3D sculpting algorithm creating the 3D model in real time"

Based on the camera orientation and the captured images we create a point cloud. The point cloud is quite rough, and consists only of points in 3D space and no color. Based on the point cloud information, a mesh is created. This mesh, or \"lump of clay\", is what we will bring to the next stage of the process - the sculpting.

The first part of the scanning is the calibration step. As you circulate slowly around the object, the camera takes images of the object. The algorithm at work looks for things that stand out in the images. Anything that can be identified and saved as a feature of the object or the surrounding environment, is a feature point. Feature points are used to calculate where in the room the camera is located in relation to the scanned object.

The mesh is, simply speaking, a bunch of 3D points connected with a wireframe. These points are called vertices. Using the points from the point cloud, the algorithm pulls and pushes the vertices trying to find a nice average place, thus allowing the mesh to shape itself better after the object.

Lastly, the app creates the texture. The texture in this context is the colors of the object. Using a few of the images captured during the sculpting, the colors are projected onto the mesh from different perspectives.
